title: Onye Akaebe nke Ọkụ ahụ
intro: Onye dị omimi, onye raara onwe ya nye ikpughe eziokwu kachasị, malitere njem nchọpụta ime mmụọ. Nkwenye ha na-enweghị mgbagha mere ka ha maa aka n'iwu ndị e guzobere eguzobe, na-eche nnukwu ule ndị na-anwale ókè okwukwe. Akụkọ mkpụrụ obi a bụ ihe akaebe nke nchebe na nduzi Chineke.
clues: E nyere m aha pụrụ iche sitere n'aka Onyenwe m, nke na-egosi njikọ miri emi na nke pụrụ iche.
Ndụ m mgbe m bụ nwata dị n'etiti ndị na-akpọ isiala nye ihe oyiyi e ji aka rụọ, mana obi m na-achọsi otu ezi Chineke ike.
Ahụrụ m ihe ndị dị n'eluigwe, anyanwụ, ọnwa, na kpakpando, na-eche echiche banyere mpụta na ọdịda ha, na-ekpebi na ha agaghị abụ Onyenwe m.
N'ime ihe megide okpukpe chi dị iche iche nke gbasaara ebe niile, m zutere chi ụgha ndị ahụ, hapụ otu chi nke ka ukwuu ka ọ bụrụ onye na-ebo ebubo n'olu na-adịghị ekwu okwu.
Ihe ịma aka m nwere maka ikpere arụsị dugara m n'ahụhụ siri ike, ebe a mara m ikpe ka a tụba m n'ọkụ na-ere ọkụ.
Ma, site n'iwu nke Onye Okike m, ọkụ dị ike gbanwere ghọọ isi iyi nke oyi na nchekwa, na-echebe ndụ m.
arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
